Something from my heart, Amrita 💗

There is something about you that makes me smile without even trying. ❤️ I really like your childish, playful nature—the way you can be cute, silly, and completely yourself. Those little things have slowly become very special to me.

I don't know if you've noticed, but my care for you comes from a place that's more than just friendship. I find myself liking you more and more, exactly as you are.

And if someday you feel the same and decide to give me a chance, I want you to know that I wouldn't treat it as something temporary. I'd want to stand beside you, care for you, and choose you through life's happy and difficult days—for the long run, for a lifetime.

I'm not saying this to put pressure on you or to ask for an answer right now. I just wanted you to know, in my own little way, that you have become someone truly special to me. 💗

Whatever your answer, your comfort and happiness matter to me. 💗

Words can say a lot… but I made one more little thing for you. 🎬
